title: Wise Guy Decides to Test His Limits, Doesn’t End Well
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On October 11, 2022, an officer attempted to stop a male subject riding a bicycle without a front light in La Crosse, WI. Police followed him for several blocks as he ignored their commands. Eventually, an officer physically defined newton’s third law of motion and the suspect was finally apprehended. Officers also discovered he had no warrants or bonds and asked why he decided to run.

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
